waypoints.name: Sunrise Mine Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Granite Falls, drive the Mountain Loop Highway east about 27 to 28 miles, then turn onto Sunrise Mine Road, Forest Road 4065. Follow roughly 2.3 to 2.5 miles of gravel to the road's end at the Sunrise Mine Trailhead, where Trail No. 707 starts. A Northwest Forest Pass is required.

waypoints.name: Vesper Peak
waypoints.directions: Take Trail 707 across the unbridged South Fork Stillaguamish and up through forest and a talus basin to the steep, loose couloir and Headlee Pass, about 2.7 miles in. Traverse below Sperry Peak into the upper Vesper Creek basin, leave the lake trail at the creek crossing, and climb the steep bootpath to treeline, then about 1,000 ft of granite slabs on the central rib, following cairns, to the summit.
